description: This file defines the StreamFactoryInterface interface within the Psr\Http\Message namespace, outlining methods for creating streams from strings, files, and resources as part of an HTTP message implementation.

classes.name: StreamFactoryInterface
classes.description: Interface defining methods for creating stream objects from various sources in an HTTP message context.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Creates a new stream from a string with an optional initial content.

methods.name: createStreamFromFile
methods.description: Creates a stream from an existing file determined by filename and mode.

methods.name: createStreamFromResource
methods.description: Creates a stream from an existing PHP resource.
